Build a reference (or contaminant) database from NCBI

Source: R/ncbi.R
build_reference_db.Rd

A one-step replacement for the shell commands previously needed to build metacleaner databases: downloads all NCBI Nucleotide records that match `term`, simplifies the headers to accessions, removes empty and (optionally) duplicate sequences and writes one sequence per line.

Usage

build_reference_db(
  term,
  file,
  dereplicate = FALSE,
  min_length = 0,
  max_records = Inf,
  keep_download = FALSE,
  api_key = Sys.getenv("ENTREZ_KEY"),
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

term

NCBI Nucleotide search term, e.g. `'(ITS2) AND Embryophyta[Organism] AND ("0"[SLEN] : "10000"[SLEN])'`.

file

Output FASTA file for the finished database.

dereplicate

Remove duplicate sequences (see [dereplicate()])? Default `FALSE`. Recommended for contaminant databases; **not** recommended for the reference database, because identical sequences from different genera are what reveals ambiguous or mislabeled entries.

min_length

Remove sequences shorter than this. Default 0.

max_records

Maximum number of records to download. Default: all.

keep_download

Keep the raw download next to `file` (with suffix `.raw.fasta`)? Default `FALSE`.

api_key

Optional NCBI API key. Defaults to the `ENTREZ_KEY` environment variable.

verbose

Print progress. Default `TRUE`.

Value

The path to `file`, invisibly.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Plant ITS1/ITS2 reference database (as used by Crone et al. 2023)
build_reference_db(
  '((((ITS1) OR 5.8S) OR 28S) OR ITS2) AND Embryophyta[Organism] AND ("0"[SLEN] : "10000"[SLEN])',
  "ITS_plants.fasta")
# Non-plant (contaminant) database
build_reference_db(
  '((((ITS1) OR 5.8S) OR 28S) OR ITS2) NOT Embryophyta[Organism] AND ("0"[SLEN] : "10000"[SLEN])',
  "ITS_nonplants.fasta", dereplicate = TRUE)
} # }
